```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml); library(glue)

find_data <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path("_data", f); if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  p2 <- file.path("..", "_data", f); if (file.exists(p2)) return(p2)
  stop(paste("Cannot find", f))
}

talks_data <- yaml::read_yaml(find_data("speaking.yml"))
talks <- talks_data$talks

# Sort by date descending
talks <- talks[order(sapply(talks, function(t) t$date), decreasing=TRUE)]

upcoming <- Filter(function(t) isTRUE(t$upcoming), talks)
past     <- Filter(function(t) !isTRUE(t$upcoming), talks)

type_label <- function(type) {
  switch(type,
    keynote   = "Keynote",
    invited   = "Invited Talk",
    conference= "Conference",
    panel     = "Panel",
    workshop  = "Workshop",
    type)
}

render_talk <- function(t) {
  date_fmt <- format(as.Date(t$date), "%b %Y")
  upcoming_badge <- if (isTRUE(t$upcoming)) '<span class="dc-talk-upcoming">Upcoming</span>' else ""
  slides <- if (!is.null(t$slides)) glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="{t$slides}" target="_blank">&darr; Slides</a>') else ""
  video  <- if (!is.null(t$video))  glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="{t$video}" target="_blank">▶ Video</a>') else ""
  links  <- if (nchar(slides)>0 || nchar(video)>0) paste0('<div class="dc-pub-links">', slides, video, '</div>') else ""
  abst   <- if (!is.null(t$abstract)) glue('<p style="font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:0.75rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted);margin-top:0.5rem;">{t$abstract}</p>') else ""
  glue('
<div class="dc-talk">
  {upcoming_badge}
  <div class="dc-talk-date">{date_fmt}<br><span style="opacity:0.6;">{type_label(t$type)}</span></div>
  <div>
    <div class="dc-talk-title">{t$title}</div>
    <div class="dc-talk-event">{t$event}</div>
    <div class="dc-talk-location">{t$location}</div>
    {abst}
    {links}
  </div>
</div>')
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (length(upcoming) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="dc-divider"><span class="dc-divider-label">Upcoming</span><div class="dc-divider-line"></div></div>\n')
  for (t in upcoming) cat(render_talk(t), "\n")
}

cat('<div class="dc-divider" style="margin-top:3rem;"><span class="dc-divider-label">Past Talks</span><div class="dc-divider-line"></div></div>\n')
for (t in past) cat(render_talk(t), "\n")
```
